Subject: Order Form kickoff — party details & exhibits request

Hi Claire,

Great to meet on the demo yesterday — thanks for the time. To get the Order Form and MSA intake moving, can you confirm the following party details and any required exhibits from FinServCo?

- Legal entity name for contracting (exact legal name)
- Billing address and billing contact (email + phone)
- Technical POC for onboarding (name + slack/email)
- Any specific exhibit attachments: insurance certificate, SOC/Security report, data processing addendum preferences
- Preferred contract owner at FinServCo and whether you need countersign on physical paper or DocuSign

Attached is a draft Order Form (spreadsheet) we typically start from — feel free to mark fields. If you have a current purchasing form we should align to, please send.

Separately, our Security team asked for a short summary of your most recent SOC/attestation and whether you can share the report or a redacted summary. If you prefer, we can accept a security addendum and a point of contact to handle the exchange securely.

Next steps from our side: once we have entity + billing info and the SOC/status, Legal (cc'd) will prepare the Order Form and initial MSA redline guidelines. I copied Marissa (CS) and Rishi (Contracts) to keep onboarding and commercial terms aligned.

Thanks — we can also set a quick 20-minute intake call if that's easier.

Best,

Kimberly Park
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com

Subject: RE: Order Form kickoff — party details & exhibits request

Thanks — tagging in Legal's intake checklist and proposed redline approach.

Responses: 
1) Data residency/encryption: standard clause set is fine; since FinServCo is US-based and is a financial services customer, add the Data Processing Addendum (DPA) and a short exhibit referencing encryption in-transit and at-rest.
2) SOC2: we prefer to receive an attestation or redacted report via a secure link under a one-way NDA. If FinServCo prefers DocuSign, we can route an NDA via DocuSign for signature before the full file exchange.
3) Payment terms: legal will not block net-30 but ask Finance whether early-pay discount is allowable — Rishi, can you advise on standard commercial levers?

Next steps from Legal: I will prepare an Order Form draft populated with the legal entity and billing contact and circulate an MSA with marked guidance (not a full redline yet) so Sales/CS can review for commercial carve-outs. Expect first pass by end of day tomorrow.

Lauren Bishop
